review_candidates.title: Director of IT
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? The Director of Information Technology will lead the hotel's IT team and will be responsible for driving operational excellence, cybersecurity, innovation, infrastructure reliability, business continuity, and guest technology services while supporting the evolving technology needs of a luxury hospitality environment. Responsibilities Lead the Information Technology team at Mandarin Orien
eligibility_evidence: Upon completion, the hotel is expected to feature approximately 276 guestrooms and suites, multiple restaurants and bars, extensive meeting and event facilities, a Spa at Mandarin Oriental, wellness amenities, and luxury guest experiences designed for both international leisure and business travelle
Minimum 8-10 years of IT experience within large-scale hospitality, luxury hotels, resorts, mixed-use developments, or multinational environments, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
Experience working with international luxury hospitality brands is preferred.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Ensure all hotel systems, applications, and infrastructure are implemented and maintained in accordance with MOHG technology standards, cybersecurity requirements, and information security policies. Ensure all IT policies, procedures, standards, and disaster recovery documentation remain updated and aligned with MOHG and corporate governance requirements. Desired Skills & Requirements Bachelor's degree or above in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 8-10 years of IT experience within large-scale hospitality, luxury hotels, resorts, mixed-use developments, or multinational environments, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
